"""Launch the existing read-only N1 exporter once, only after its queue ends."""
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

root = Path('/tmp/s4_21usr_n1_20261113_0210')
bundle = root/'light-light126-n1-v4-20261113_045945-0f62e4120790'
queue = bundle/'runs/n1_acceptance01'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert sha(queue/'request.json') == '53028caf11703f75c159e19de43627f12cf7a63cde6e14b886c71937a424b944'
cfg = json.loads((queue/'request.json').read_text())
state = json.loads((queue/'state.json').read_text())
assert state['status'] == 'numbers_ready_independent_review_required'
assert state['child_pid'] is None and len(state['completed']) == 13
try:
    os.kill(state['pid'], 0)
except ProcessLookupError:
    pass
else:
    raise RuntimeError('Original queue driver has not exited')
ops = Path(cfg['precision_operations'])
request = ops/'final_request01.json'
assert json.loads(request.read_text())['queue_provenance']['state_sha256'] == sha(queue/'state.json')
assert sha(ops/'manifest.json') == cfg['precision_operations_manifest_sha256']
for name, item in json.loads((ops/'manifest.json').read_text())['files'].items():
    assert sha(ops/name) == item['sha256']
server = json.loads((bundle/'handoff/team/server_config.json').read_text())
assert not (Path(server['server_root'])/'.arch02_team_lock').exists()
assert not (ops/'final_report01').exists()
control = ops/'final_export_control01'
control.mkdir()
worker = '''import datetime,hashlib,json,os,sys,traceback
from pathlib import Path
os.environ['OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS']='1'
sys.path[:0]=PATHS
import n1_report as report
ops=Path(OPS)
control=ops/'final_export_control01'
state=dict(schema='n1-final-export-state-v1',status='running',pid=os.getpid(),started=datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(),n2_allowed=False)
def save():
    p=control/'state.json.tmp'
    p.write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2)+'\\n')
    p.replace(control/'state.json')
save()
try:
    request=ops/'final_request01.json'
    digest=report.sha(request)
    result=report.build(json.loads(request.read_text()))
    assert report.sha(request)==digest
    result['request_sha256']=digest
    report.write(result,ops/'final_report01')
    state.update(status='exported_independent_review_required',report_sha256=report.sha(ops/'final_report01/report.json'),receipt_sha256=report.sha(ops/'final_report01/receipt.json'))
    print('N1_FINAL_EXPORT_COMPLETE independent_review_required=true',flush=True)
except BaseException as exc:
    state.update(status='failed',error=str(exc))
    traceback.print_exc()
    raise
finally:
    state['finished']=datetime.datetime.now().isoformat()
    save()
'''.replace('PATHS', repr([cfg['numpy_root'], str(ops/'scripts'), str(bundle/'workspaces/arch03/scripts')])).replace('OPS', repr(str(ops)))
(control/'worker.py').write_text(worker)
with (control/'driver.log').open('x') as log:
    child = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-B','-u',str(control/'worker.py')],stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
(control/'launch.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(pid=child.pid,worker_sha256=sha(control/'worker.py'),request_sha256=sha(request)),indent=2)+'\n')
print('N1_FINAL_EXPORT_LAUNCHED',child.pid,str(control),flush=True)
